topics.label: AI protein structure & binding prediction (AlphaFold3 / Boltz)
topics.description: Next-generation structure and binding-affinity prediction tools, led by AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2, are being applied to antibody/immune-receptor modeling, protein-ligand potency, and structure-based drug discovery.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. AlphaFold3 (226x, n=263) and Boltz-2 (339x, n=50) are named real tools released 2024-2025; growth reflects a genuine method wave, not indexing.

topics.label: LLMs / foundation chat models in biomedicine
topics.description: General-purpose large language models (GPT-4o/5, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Sonnet) are being evaluated and deployed for clinical Q&A, literature mining, information extraction, and protein/genomics reasoning.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. Multiple independent named-model terms (gpt-4o 61x, gpt-5 352x, sonnet 386x, deepseek 318x, claude 27x) corroborate a real, fast LLM adoption wave in author text.

topics.label: Agentic AI & autonomous reasoning systems
topics.description: Agent-based AI workflows that chain LLM reasoning, tools, and planning for tasks like single-cell analysis, RNA-seq pipelines, and target ranking.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. 'agentic' (101x, n=117) and 'ai-driven' (8.9x, n=390) are real author coinages with concrete exemplars.

topics.label: Retrieval-augmented generation & knowledge assistants
topics.description: RAG architectures and natural-language/MCP query interfaces that ground LLM outputs in curated biomedical knowledge bases and ontologies.
topics.artifact_risk: Low but small-n. RAG terms (27x, n=86) and natural-language MCP interfaces (41x, n=48) are real but emerging; modest document counts.

topics.label: Genomic / DNA sequence foundation models
topics.description: Self-supervised, pretrained foundation models over genomic and metagenomic sequence (DNA language models, long-range genomic transformers) for annotation and trait prediction.
topics.artifact_risk: Moderate. Preprint 'genomic foundation' (359x, n=53) and 'foundation' (n=4039) are solid; grant 'self supervised learning' (945x) plausibly a real method surge but inflated by RePORTER vocabulary onset.

topics.label: Single-cell & spatial foundation models
topics.description: Foundation models trained on single-cell and spatial omics to enable zero-shot cell-type annotation, perturbation prediction, and cross-platform embeddings.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. 'single-cell foundation' (23x, n=73) is a real, named emerging subfield with concrete exemplars (batch effects, differentiation).

topics.label: Protein language models & ML protein design
topics.description: Protein language models (ESM-2 and successors) and generative/chain-of-thought models for protein embeddings, thermostability, affinity prediction, and de novo design.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. esm-2 (10x, n=113), 'protein language' (3.2x, n=605) and chain-of-thought protein reasoning are concrete named methods.

topics.label: Interpretable / zero-shot / generative ML methods
topics.description: Cross-cutting ML methodology surge: explainable AI (SHAP), zero-shot learning, generative models, embeddings, and multimodal architectures applied across biology.
topics.artifact_risk: Moderate. Real methods but some terms ('biologically grounded' 47x, 'biologically coherent' 28x) are partly writing-style phrasing; grant 'multimodal modeling' (846x) likely vocabulary-onset inflated.

topics.label: MASLD/MASH steatotic liver disease (renaming)
topics.description: The 2023 nomenclature shift from NAFLD/NASH to MASLD/MASH (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease/steatohepatitis), with new therapeutics (resmetirom) and disease-model research.
topics.artifact_risk: Low as a real trend, but partly a nomenclature change: the many near-duplicate MASLD substrings (15-18x) reflect one renaming event driving consistent author adoption — genuine and well-corroborated.

topics.label: Spatial transcriptomics & in situ profiling
topics.description: Spatially resolved transcriptomics platforms (Xenium, NanoString) and analysis methods mapping gene expression to tissue architecture, including clinical/diagnostic applications.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. Preprint (2.5x, n=1392) plus named platforms Xenium (9.8x) and NanoString corroborate; grant 56.6x partly vocabulary onset but consistent with real platform diffusion.

topics.label: Single-cell & single-nucleus multi-omics
topics.description: Single-cell/single-nucleus genomics and ATAC-seq, including multimodal epigenomic+transcriptomic profiling, atlases, and single-cell proteomics.
topics.artifact_risk: Moderate. Real field, but grant 'single cell atac-seq' (5828x, prior_n~0) is largely a RePORTER pref_term vocabulary onset; preprint single-nucleus/single-cell signals are trustworthy.

topics.label: iPSC-derived & induced cell models
topics.description: Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neurons, cardiomyocytes, and directly induced cells used as disease models and for therapeutic differentiation.
topics.artifact_risk: Moderate. iPSC is an established field; high grant growth (99x for 'human induced pluripotent', n=2644) likely reflects RePORTER term standardization rather than pure novelty, but the underlying research is real.

topics.label: Aging biology, senescence & longevity
topics.description: Hallmarks-of-aging research: cellular senescence and SASP, epigenetic aging clocks, lifespan/healthspan extension, proteostasis loss, stem cell exhaustion, and aging reversal.
topics.artifact_risk: Moderate. Aging biology is a genuine, broad surge, but many grant substrings ('extend lifespan' 5609x, 'senescence secretory phenotype' 3650x, 'aging mechanism' 3194x) are inflated RePORTER pref_term onsets; treat the topic as real but the absolute growth numbers as partly artifactual.

topics.label: Community-engaged & participatory research
topics.description: Community advisory boards, community-academic partnerships, lived experience, care partners, and culturally appropriate interventions in health research.
topics.artifact_risk: High on numbers. 'community advisory board' (11903x, n=2169) and most community terms are near-certainly RePORTER pref_term vocabulary onsets (prior_n~0). The topic is a real funder priority, but growth multipliers are artifacts; treat as moderate.

topics.label: Health disparities: women & minority populations
topics.description: Research on disproportionate disease burden in women and in American Indian/Alaska Native and other underserved populations, plus language access (Spanish/English).
topics.artifact_risk: High. Most terms (prior_n~0, e.g. 'disproportionately impacts women' 2574x, 'white women' 3749x, 'alaska native population' 1691x) are RePORTER pref_term vocabulary onsets and/or writing boilerplate, not measurable research trends.

topics.label: Disability & functional impairment outcomes
topics.description: Grant emphasis on functional/physical impairment, long-term and lifelong disability, mobility decline, symptom burden, and debilitating chronic conditions.
topics.artifact_risk: High. Nearly all are RePORTER pref_term onsets (prior_n~0) with absurd multipliers; reflects funder vocabulary/priority language rather than a discrete research method trend.

topics.label: Older adults & late-life health
topics.description: Population-health focus on older adults, late/later life, age-related disease, dementia burden, and aging-related healthcare burden.
topics.artifact_risk: High. 'older adult' (191x), 'aging process' (506x), 'age-related disease' (197x) are RePORTER vocabulary-onset terms; a real demographic priority but not a measurable acceleration.

topics.label: Gene editing & gene-targeted therapy
topics.description: Gene-editing technologies (CRISPR-era), gene-targeted/gene-modified therapies, T-cell receptor therapy, and viral-vector (adenovirus-mediated) delivery.
topics.artifact_risk: High on numbers. Underlying field is real and active, but grant substrings ('gene-targeted therapy' 1581x, prior_n~0) are RePORTER vocabulary onsets; preprint 'prime editing' exemplars support genuine activity.

topics.label: H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza
topics.description: Resurgent HPAI H5N1 outbreak research, including spillover to dairy cattle, the wild-waterfowl/poultry interface, and zoonotic transmission risk.
topics.artifact_risk: Low. 'influenza hpai h5n1' (41x, n=48) is a real, datable 2024-25 outbreak surge with concrete exemplars (bovine semen, waterfowl-poultry interface).

topics.label: Emerging arbo/flaviviruses & antiviral targets
topics.description: Orthoflavivirus and alphavirus biology (Oropouche, dengue, restriction factors) and broad-spectrum antiviral development against emerging/drug-resistant viral variants.
topics.artifact_risk: Mixed. Preprint 'orthoflavivirus' (318x, n=47) is a genuine taxonomy-driven trend; grant 'anti-viral agents' (7343x), 'anti-viral response' (4171x), 'alpha virus' (1093x) are RePORTER pref_term onsets — treat grant numbers as artifacts.

topics.label: Antimicrobials, AMR & antimicrobial peptides
topics.description: Antimicrobial, antifungal, and antimalarial agents; antimicrobial peptides; and broad-spectrum antimicrobial-resistance prediction and discovery.
topics.artifact_risk: High. Grant 'anti-fungal agents' (3853x), 'anti-malarials' (2745x), 'anti-microbial peptide' (2399x) are almost certainly RePORTER drug-class pref_term vocabulary onsets (prior_n~0), flagged in the task as not real trends.

topics.label: Neurodegeneration & proteinopathies
topics.description: TDP-43 proteinopathy and related neurodegenerative disease mechanisms (ALS/FTD, Alzheimer's tau/amyloid) studied in human neuron and organoid models.
topics.artifact_risk: Mixed. 'tdp43 proteinopathy' (1175x) and 'fmr1 gene' (1126x) are RePORTER vocabulary onsets, but the underlying neurodegeneration research is genuine and corroborated by preprint exemplars (TDP-43, tau).

topics.label: Spatial/single-cell computational analysis methods
topics.description: Computational toolkits for omics: dimension reduction, lineage tracing, droplet digital methods, and quality-control/benchmarking pipelines for single-cell and spatial data.
topics.artifact_risk: High on grant side. 'dimension reduction' (1998x), 'droplet digital' (890x), 'lineage tracing' (72x) read as RePORTER vocabulary onsets; methods are real but growth is largely indexing-driven.

topics.label: mHealth & digital health interventions
topics.description: Mobile-health and technology-based interventions, including culturally appropriate digital interventions for underserved populations.
topics.artifact_risk: High. 'culturally appropriate intervention' (1856x) and 'mhealth interventions' (53x) are likely RePORTER vocabulary onsets; real funder interest but not a measurable preprint method trend.

excluded.cluster: Writing-style boilerplate adverbs/adjectives: preserving, incompletely, spanning, traditional, limited, often, crucial, despite, whereas, primarily, markedly, pronounced, notable, essential, conventional, demonstrated, thereby, rather, increasingly recognized, jointly shape, often fail capture
excluded.reason: Generic English connective/intensifier words with huge n and low growth (1.2-3x); pure prose style, not research topics, and would massively false-match.

excluded.cluster: Generic method-paper vocabulary: validation, benchmarking, workflow(s), datasets, metrics, reproducible, scalability, interpretable, actionable, standardized, modular, integration, profiling, transcriptomic (bare)
excluded.reason: Ubiquitous methods-section words; too generic to discriminate a topic and overlap many real clusters; kept only as keywords inside specific topics where appropriate.

excluded.cluster: RePORTER drug-class pref_term onsets: anti-viral agents (7343x), anti-fungal agents (3853x), anti-depressive agents (3837x), anti-hypertensive agents (2503x), anti-epileptic agents (1104x), anti-diabetic drugs (1291x), fda-approved drug, regulatory approval, formulation optimization
excluded.reason: prior_n~0 with absurd growth — classic RePORTER controlled-vocabulary additions, explicitly flagged in the task as vocabulary changes rather than real trends.

excluded.cluster: Fragmented multi-gram RePORTER substrings: 'targets release nuclease', 'cleavage targets release', 'release nuclease', 'targets release' (all 5356x, n=976); 'structural mutation', 'congenital heart abnormality', 'heart abnormality'
excluded.reason: Overlapping n-gram fragments of the same indexed phrase with identical counts/growth; indexing artifacts, not coherent topics.
Time-window strings and residual COVID-era phrasing that spike from temporal indexing rather than a forward-looking research trend.

excluded.cluster: Bare single-word grant tokens: span, life span, lines, board, partners, older, younger, lived, extend, hallmarks, dedications, acceleration, upregulation, interferon-
excluded.reason: Truncated/ambiguous single tokens (often substrings of real topics like aging or community); too generic to stand alone and high false-match risk; folded into parent topics as keywords where meaningful.
